📖 How to use

  1. Type or paste your text.
  2. Read the live per-vowel counts.
  3. Check the total and vowel ratio.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What does it count?

Counts a, e, i, o, u (case-insensitive) and shows each vowel separately plus the total and the share of all letters.

Is it live?

Yes — results update live with every keystroke.

What is the vowel ratio?

The ratio is vowels ÷ total letters (a–z only), shown as a percentage — typical English is around 38%.
